name: Souma Ria
source:
A moody, delinquent girl in a different class from [url=/c64498]Ouro[/url]. She's a smoker and has been suspended a number of times. Ria has quite the foul mouth, seems bored with everything, and has become incredibly cynical.

She's developed a reputation for being a hoodlum, so only happy-go lucky people—like [url=/c64303]Reina[/url]—approach her.

"Tch, don't tell anyone. Not about this place, at least. This is my special seat."

[From [url=http://kinkoi.nekonyansoft.com/chara04.html]NekoNyan[/url]]

[spoiler]In an alternate timeline, it is revealed that she survives her surgery and is the wife to Ouro, avoiding death.[/spoiler]
